text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Good morning, world! What possibilities will you reveal to me today?
Gyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter?! I heard a scream come from over here!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, apologies for the commotion! El asked me to teach her how to do zazen meditation, you see…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Since when did zazen meditation involve screaming?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: …Hey, would you mind teaching me as well? I'm interested to know what kind of meditation had El screaming like that!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Pearl… Turn back now before it's too late! I couldn't even last five minutes…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Worry not! The more difficult the challenge, the more I get fired up to show you what's possible!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well then, close your eyes and try to keep still. Focus on facing your inner self.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (Haha. Even in darkness, my heart is free. I can go wherever I please!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (I can feel the breeze blowing through the palace gardens.)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (I could even walk down a snowy trail.)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (I know! What if I use this opportunity to fly around the world?!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (I can compete in every race that ever was! It doesn't matter where they are, how long they are, or even when they took place!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (Oh! So, that's what my possibilities truly are…)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: …Pearl. Please, open your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh? Is it over already?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Wow, you didn't move an inch! You were like a statue!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You have incredible focus. How do you feel?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Well… It sort of feels like I've been born again. I was able to travel around the world and gain some new insights just now.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean you traveled the world?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. ♪ To put it simply…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: As long as I have this heart of mine, the possibilities I possess are limitless!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Grass, you have my thanks! And…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Good night, world! ♪ Today, you showed me a glimpse of what's truly possible.
